name: A wet floor
prompt: You turn with a full pan of hash browns, and your foot finds the wet patch by the dish pit.

outcome.told: The pan clatters across the tiles. You lose the hash browns and keep your feet.

choices.text: Try to keep the pan and your feet

outcome.told: You catch yourself on the counter. The hash browns stay in the pan.

failure.told: You go down on one knee, and the pan goes anyway. The knee swells by the end of the shift.
